entities.name: DNA polymerase III alpha
observations: 768-aa query has a reviewed UniProt homolog Q89AN8 from Buchnera aphidicola, with 57.8% identity, 99.3% query coverage, and E-value 3.32e-312; supports identification as bacterial DNA polymerase III alpha.

Homology-based functional annotation: replicative DNA-directed DNA polymerase, associated with bacterial DNA replication; candidate reaction extends DNA using a deoxyribonucleoside triphosphate and releases diphosphate.
Query Pfam hits: PHP domain at residues 9–172, DNA_pol3_alpha at 291–558, and DNA_pol3_finger at 561–735.
Reference homolog is annotated cytoplasmic and with 3′-to-5′ exonuclease activity; these annotations are not independently established for the query sequence.
